title: Grateful Dead Live at Kezar Stadium on 1973-05-26
lineage: Transfer and FLAC encoding by David Minches: Master played back on Nakamichi Dragon > Digital Audio Labs Card Deluxe soundcard> HD Editing performed in Adobe Audition; Flac Encoded
source: Recording by Gene Taback: Master Audience Cassette; Sony TC-124 with Sony Stereo Mic

ai_review.summary: Lo‑Fi soundboard capture with clear vocals and guitars but narrow stereo field and low fidelity
ai_review.review: The tape is praised as a surprisingly clean soundboard source given its age, with Jerry’s guitar and Bob’s rhythm work audible and the bass retaining some punch. However, the recording suffers from a narrow stereo image and overall lo‑fi fidelity, making it more of a nostalgic listen than a high‑definition experience.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one detailed review that focuses on recording quality (fair) and offers no strong commentary on the musical performance, yielding an average overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear vocals, Jerry’s guitar and Bob’s rhythm are audible; bass has some punch. Stereo field is narrow and fidelity low, with occasional crowd handclaps that are not overly intrusive.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewer does not discuss the musical flow or specific songs; focus is entirely on the tape’s technical attributes.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Guitar tone described as clear and audible.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass noted to still have a little punch.
band_member_comments.Bob: Rhythm guitar can be heard throughout.
